A is slightly better. Both identify the same main issues (DST breaking the `Math.floor` day count, silent NaN handling, timezone dependence, and staleness after midnight) and both give a working fix. A is more accurate on the DST impact: it correctly says the overdue list is unaffected because the sign stays right. B claims the fall-back case "may land in the wrong place on the overdue list," which is wrong. Both responses run slightly over 200 words, so neither has a clear edge on length.

A
